title: Westminster Abbey £31. Temple of Heaven, All 3 Sights: ¥34 | China Travel Expert
description:
Westminster Abbey charges adults £31 — about $41. Beijing's Temple of Heaven? The combined ticket is ¥34 in peak season (Apr–Oct), roughly $5. That's about eight times the price for the London church.

And the ¥34 combined ticket isn't just the park — it covers all three of the Temple of Heaven's monuments: the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, the Echo Wall and the Circular Mound Altar. The park-only ticket (¥15) skips them, so buy the combined one. From Nov 1 the combined ticket drops to ¥28.

🧭 Expert Tip: buy the combined ticket (联票), not the ¥15 park-only ticket — only the combined one gets you inside the three main halls.

英国西敏寺成人票 £31（约 $41），北京天坛联票旺季 ¥34（约 $5），差约 8 倍；联票才含祈年殿等三大景点，别只买 ¥15 大门票。
